advisory.finding: The change's headline retained invariant - stale-material still blocks, so attest-then-edit-the-plan is not a bypass - has no regression test exercising the NEW classify_plan_review_attestation chain. The classifier now hand-builds a `shaped` dict (with hardcoded `verified: True`, mapping material_fingerprint/merged_log_commit/signed_at) and delegates to compute_validity, replacing the removed verify_opcert path. No test in the changed file mints a plan-review attestation, edits the plan, and asserts the gate blocks with verdict `stale-material` through this new code. Existing stale-material coverage (tests/unit/test_attestation_invalidation.py:730) calls verify_opcert_record+compute_validity directly, bypassing the gate's new shaped-dict construction, and the retrigger suite stubs the classifier - so a regression in the new `shaped` mapping would silently defeat the documented non-bypassability guarantee undetected.
